Edge 'replication (async)' between two RDS instances in one VPC is not a valid cross-region DR mechanism (no DR VPC, no cross-region link shown)
Two independent Auto Scaling groups (scale1 on web1, scale2 on web2) instead of a single scaling group spanning the web tier across zones a and b.
Narration says 'scale out on weekends' but no scaling rule type (scheduled vs metric-based on load) is indicated, despite the user asking for load-based scaling.
No mention that ESS auto-registers scaled instances with the ALB, which is key to the design working.
Model Studio agent apps and knowledge base are closed to new international accounts per catalog, though basic Qwen API access should still work
Narration mentions Cloud Enterprise Network for Singapore access but this is not reflected in the architecture diagram

failed: every attachment names a valid host
defects: Express Connect is a vpc-edge/boundary service; placing the node inside the VPC is a minor placement inaccuracy
PrivateZone is a badge on the VPC per catalog, not a standalone regional node
Narration is brief and does not explicitly confirm the no-public-exposure guarantee or PrivateZone rationale
내레이션에서 '프랑크푸르트 OSS 에셋 복제 권장'과 '이전 답변의 유럽 에셋 복제 제거'가 모순되어 혼란을 줄 수 있음
유럽 유저 지연 대응으로 ESA 외 구체적 개선 조치(예: 동적 가속 설명)가 다소 추상적
api and workers use product ecs ('pods on ACK nodes' is contradictory); they should be workloads of the ACK cluster, not separate ECS instances
cluster->api/workers edges are a workaround for the wrong product choice; ALB should ingress into ACK
Turn 1 avoid list covered only three Kubernetes ids per the review note, leaving the rest of the K8s family unchecked

db-replica is placed in the same Kuala Lumpur VPC/region, so a region-level failure takes out both primary and standby; cross-region DR to Johor (ap-southeast-8) is allowed under the residency pin and is the expected design
Replica node spans zones a,b in the same VPC, duplicating the primary's failure domain rather than adding a new one
Narration claims the cross-zone standby 'satisfies' DR without acknowledging the lack of regional-failure protection or the Johor option
Narration references GA (Global Accelerator) which is not in the catalog and not drawn in the diagram
Read replica exposed via public EIP/NLB instead of a private connectivity option (e.g., CEN/VPN); security weakness for HR data
Narration is somewhat contradictory: says 'GA endpoints must stay in Europe' then says US connects over public internet, without clarifying the final choice cleanly
Two independent Auto Scaling groups (scale1 on web1, scale2 on web2) instead of a single scaling group spanning the web tier across zones a and b.
Narration says 'scale out on weekends' but no scaling rule type (scheduled vs metric-based on load) is indicated, despite the user asking for load-based scaling.
No mention that ESS auto-registers scaled instances with the ALB, which is key to the design working.
NAT Gateway is added as a resilience fix, but the design does not explain why outbound NAT is needed for FC-to-RDS or how it prevents the prior outage.
CloudMonitor edges are drawn from app nodes to monitoring, but monitoring is typically an external control-plane service rather than a data-path dependency.
No concrete multi-zone or failover change is made to the app tier; the design still relies on a single regional serverless setup.
